title: A Parts Manager with no evidence starts off and leaves the board
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as an Admin of the production test account, at its test location, Trucks Hill 2.
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a new staff member for this test on production, staff member A, active, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on, Billable set to No, enrolled at Trucks Hill 2, with no work at all, and with a column on Board View at Trucks Hill 2 before the release (screenshot) (written down with a screenshot of the staff record).
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings, Staff.
  2. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  3. Open Work Orders, Board View, at Trucks Hill 2.
  4. Open the Technician filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member A's row shows "No" in the Technician column.

Step 2:

  • Technician is off.
  • Time Clock is still on.

Step 3:

  • Staff member A no longer has a column.
  • The technicians who had a column before the release still have one.

Step 4:

  • Staff member A is not offered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists), story SV-11884 (Story 6, Release day)

  • S6-N1: “A staff member who meets none of S6-R1 (for example a Parts Manager who never works on work orders and is not billable) starts with Technician off and leaves the technician lists.”
  • S6-R2: “Every other staff member starts with Technician off.”
  • Goals: “A shop can take a Parts Manager (or anyone who is not a technician) off Board View, Tech View and every technician dropdown while that person keeps clocking in.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs the before values taken on production shortly before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
